title: Inherent Trade-offs when Enforcing Correct Data Symmetries in Multi-head Self-attention
summary: We give a complete characterization of equivariant multi-head self-attention (MHSA): if an MHSA layer is equivariant to a symmetry group $G$, then $G$ can only act by permuting head-clusters, with QK and OV matrices satisfying an equivariance constraint tied to the group action.
